headline: Timed Entry Required for Black Sand Beach Access
reservation: Non-resident visitors must have a pre-paid reservation for both vehicle parking and entry to Waianapanapa State Park. These slots fill quickly and are mandatory for access to the black sand beach and coastal trails. Verify the current booking window on the official Hawaii State Parks website before your trip.

days.title: The Road to Hana Landscape

stops.name: Waikamoi Ridge Trail
stops.detail: An established forest loop offering a look at native plants and tropical trees away from the road.

stops.name: Garden of Eden Arboretum
stops.detail: A private botanical garden with views of Puohokamoa Falls and Keopuka Rock.

days.driving: Allow 4-6 hours for the drive to Hana; conditions vary by traffic and rain
days.note: Respect 'no parking' signs and avoid blocking one-lane bridges for local traffic.

days.title: Black Sands and Coastal Caves

stops.name: Waianapanapa State Park
stops.detail: View the iconic Pailoa black sand beach and the natural stone arch from the Ke Ala Loa O Maui trail.

stops.name: Hana Bay Beach Park
stops.detail: A local hub for outrigger canoes with views of the historic Kauiki Head cinder cone.

days.note: Wear sturdy footwear for walking on uneven, sharp lava rock along the coast.

days.title: Hana Cultural Heritage

stops.name: Hana Cultural Center & Museum
stops.detail: Learn about the history of the Hana district and indigenous Hawaiian culture.

stops.name: Kahanu Garden
stops.detail: Home to Pi'ilanihale Heiau, one of the largest ancient temples in Polynesia.

days.note: Verify opening hours for cultural sites as they may vary seasonally.

intel.title: Waianapanapa Reservations
intel.text: Strict enforcement of timed entry means you must leave by the end of your scheduled slot. Roadside parking outside the park gate is prohibited and subject to towing.

intel.title: Digital Dead Zones
intel.text: Most of the Hana Highway has no cellular or data service. Download offline maps and confirm all reservation details before leaving the north shore.

intel.title: Last Stop Supplies
intel.text: Fuel in Hana town is limited and often more expensive than in central Maui. Ensure your tank is full before leaving Paia for the outbound journey.

intel.title: Daylight Road Safety
intel.text: The highway features over 50 one-lane bridges and hundreds of curves. Plan to be off the road before dark, as there are no streetlights and navigation becomes difficult.

intel.title: Private Property Boundaries
intel.text: Many waterfalls along the road are on private land or within watershed areas. Only use established public parks and waysides to avoid trespassing.

plan.arrival: Arrive at Hana Airport (HNM) for a local stay or pick up a rental in Kahului for the scenic drive east.
plan.vehicle: Compact or mid-size cars are best for narrow bridges; check rental contracts regarding the 'back road' south of Kipahulu.
plan.goldenHour: Hana Bay offers soft morning light against the red cinder of Kauiki Head, depending on coastal cloud patterns.
